name: Passioners
source:
Passioners is a steamy visual novel set aboard a colonization spacecraft. Awakened from cryosleep too soon, the protagonist faces isolation but decides to awaken others, sparking forbidden desires and intense encounters.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363390/PASSIONERS/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Passioners是一部以殖民飞船为背景的热辣视觉小说。主角过早从冷冻睡眠中醒来，面临孤立，但决定唤醒其他人，引发禁忌的欲望和激烈的遭遇。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363390/PASSIONERS/]Steam[/url]]
